德国 2024 年 6 月起实施的求职居留许可：凭学历或职业资格加积分（满分制，: A job-seeker residence permit introduced in Germany in June 2024: enter Germany on the strength of a recognised qualification plus a points score (minimum 6 points) and look for work for up to 1 year, extendable to at most 2 more years once a qualifying job is found. While holding the card you may work up to 20 hours per week on average and take trial placements of up to two weeks each. Mainland Chinese holders of a bachelor's degree or above can apply, provided the qualification is recognised in Germany.
法规未按国籍设限。中国大陆护照持有人可申，两条硬门槛：①学历或职业资格被德国主管: The statute sets no nationality restriction. Mainland Chinese passport holders may apply, subject to two hard requirements: (1) the degree or vocational qualification is recognised by the competent German authority (degrees are usually checked against the anabin database); (2) you either qualify as a skilled worker (Fachkraft) or score at least 6 points.
年龄不设上下限，只影响积分：申请时不超过 35 岁得 2 分，36 至 40 岁: No age floor or ceiling; age only affects the points score. Being 35 or younger at application earns 2 points, 36 to 40 earns 1 point, and over 40 earns none (§20b(1) nos. 9 and 10). A 0-99 range here means 'no age requirement', not 'unverified'.
两条路径：①被认定为「专业人士」（Fachkraft），即持德国认可的高等学历，: Two routes: (1) be recognised as a skilled worker (Fachkraft) — holding a German-recognised higher-education degree, or a vocational qualification requiring at least two years of training and officially recognised in the country where it was obtained; (2) use the points system, which requires a foreign higher-education degree or a recognised vocational qualification. Recognition is usually checked against anabin; a regular bachelor's degree from an institution recognised by China's Ministry of Education normally maps to a German equivalent.
走积分制时须满足其一：基础德语（至少 A1 级简单德语），或英语达到 CEFR: Under the points route you need one of: basic German (simple German at A1 or above), or English at CEFR B2. Higher German levels score more — good German, sufficient German and C1 English each earn points separately. The skilled-worker route applies its own language rules. No specific test provider is named; only a demonstrable level is required.
法规明文要求生计有保障（`der Lebensunterhalt gesiche: The statute explicitly requires a secured livelihood (`der Lebensunterhalt gesichert ist`): proof of funds or an income source inside Germany. No amount is fixed in law; in practice local cost of living and general residence-permit standards apply, and the figure is decided by the local foreigners authority.
长期居留许可的常规要求，须提供德国认可的医疗保险证明；具体体检项目由各地外管局与: A standard requirement for long-stay permits: proof of German-recognised health insurance. Any specific medical checks are set by the local foreigners authority and the mission abroad.
须持德国可用的医疗保险，覆盖整个居留期。: Health insurance valid in Germany, covering the whole period of stay.
法规未设个人名额上限，但明文授权联邦政府以行政法规按年度或更短周期限制尚未在德人: The statute sets no per-person cap, but expressly authorises the federal government to limit, by regulation, the number of Opportunity Cards issued to people not yet in Germany, annually or for shorter periods (§20a(7)). As of the verification date no such limit was in force.
全年可申请，无固定开放窗口。官方不公布年度配额公告，若未来设限会在联邦法律公报发: Applications run year-round with no fixed window. No annual quota notice is published; any future limit would appear in the Federal Law Gazette, so check again before lodging.
现行规则：先批最长 1 年的求职机会卡（Such-Chancenkarte）。: Current rule: an initial job-seeker Opportunity Card (Such-Chancenkarte) of up to 1 year.
官方未在本页公布审理周期（未能核实）。实务上德国国家签证通常需数周至数月，取决于: Processing time is not published on this page (unverified). In practice German national visas take weeks to months depending on mission availability.
有效期覆盖计划居留期: Valid for the whole planned stay
须能对应 anabin 数据库条目；非德语/英语材料需认证翻译: Must map to an anabin entry; documents not in German or English need certified translations
学历认定证明（ANABIN 查询结果或 Zeugnisbewertung）: Proof of qualification recognition (anabin result or Zeugnisbewertung)
证明学历与德国学位等效，是走积分制的前提: Establishes equivalence with a German degree; a precondition for the points route
基础德语（A1 及以上）或英语 B2；分数越高越好，直接挂钩积分: Basic German (A1 or above) or English B2; higher levels score more points
证明在德期间生计有保障: Proof that your livelihood is secured while in Germany
覆盖整个居留期: Covering the whole period of stay
按 §20b Abs.1 的 12 项逐条计分，总分须达 6 分: Score each of the 12 criteria in §20b(1); the total must reach 6 points
先算积分，确认够 6 分: Score yourself first and confirm you reach 6 points
按 12 项逐条计分：职业资格认定 4 分、良好德语 3 分、足够德语 2 分、: The 12 criteria: recognised vocational qualification 4 points, good German 3, sufficient German 2, basic German 1, C1 English 1, 5 years' experience 3, 2 years' experience 2, shortage occupation 1, age 35 or under 2, age 36-40 1, at least 6 months of lawful residence in Germany in the past 5 years 1, spouse applying jointly 1. Minimum is 6 points. Below 6 you must use the skilled-worker route instead.
确认学历被德国认可: Confirm your qualification is recognised in Germany
查 anabin 数据库，确认你的学校与学位在列。不在列或状态不明时，需申请 Z: Check anabin for your institution and degree. If either is missing or unclear, apply for a Zeugnisbewertung (statement of comparability). This is the slowest step, so start it first.
德语 A1 或英语 B2 起步；资金证明按各地外管局口径准备。语言等级越高，积分: German A1 or English B2 is the floor; funds evidence follows the local foreigners authority. Higher language levels give more points headroom.
向德国驻华使领馆递交国家签证申请: Lodge the national visa application at a German mission in China

入境后找工作，找到即申请延长: Job-hunt after entry, then apply to extend once you have an offer
持求职机会卡每周最多工作 20 小时，可做最长两周的试工。拿到合格岗位的劳动合同: With the job-seeker card you may work up to 20 hours per week and take trial placements of up to two weeks. Once you hold a contract or a written job offer for a qualifying position, you can switch in-country to a follow-up Opportunity Card (Folge-Chancenkarte) of up to 2 years, or straight to a work residence permit.
求职机会卡首批发最长 1 年。持卡期间若拿到德国合格岗位的劳动合同或具约束力的录: The job-seeker card is first issued for up to 1 year. If during that time you obtain a contract or binding job offer for a qualifying German position and the Federal Employment Agency agrees, you may extend in-country as a follow-up Opportunity Card for up to 2 more years (§20a(5)). A follow-up card is only issued to people who do not yet meet the conditions for another Chapter 4 permit. No extension beyond that is allowed.
持卡期间允许：平均每周合计不超过 20 小时的工作；每段最长两周的试工（须为合格: Permitted while holding the card: work averaging no more than 20 hours per week in total; trial placements of up to two weeks each (which must be a qualifying position, aimed at training, or usable within a qualification-recognition procedure). The card is not a work permit — once you find a regular job you must switch to the matching work residence permit.
不是工作许可。每周 20 小时上限意味着无法靠它全职就业，找到正式岗位后必须转换: It is not a work permit. The 20-hour weekly cap rules out full-time employment, and you must change permit type once you land a regular job.
积分制 6 分门槛卡人。学历认定（4 分或 0 分）几乎决定成败——学历不被认可: The 6-point threshold is the real filter. Qualification recognition (4 points or nothing) is close to decisive — without it, language and experience rarely add up to 6.
学历认定耗时长（可达 3 个月），且需在递交签证前完成。启动晚了会错过计划入境时: Recognition is slow (up to 3 months) and must be done before you lodge. Starting late means missing your intended entry date.
法规授权联邦政府按年度限制发放数量（§20a Abs.7）。目前未见到生效公告，: The statute lets the federal government cap issuance annually (§20a(7)). No limit is in force today, but the authority exists — re-check before lodging.
资金证明无统一数额，由各地外管局判断，同一份材料在不同城市可能结论不同。: There is no uniform funds figure; the local foreigners authority decides, so the same evidence can be judged differently in different cities.
优势：不需要先有工作offer即可入境；年龄 35 岁及以下直接拿 2 分；英语: Advantages: you can enter without a job offer; being 35 or under is worth 2 points outright; C1 English also scores, so German is not strictly required; it is the lowest-friction entry from a STEM background into the German labour market.

伴侣与子女如符合条件可一同申请居留，不是一律禁止；但与部分短期签证不同，本签证允: Partners and children may apply to stay too if they are eligible; unlike some short-term visas, dependants are allowed here.
无名额上限，全年可申请，按个人毕业时间滚动递交。唯一的时间限制是必须在学生签证到: No cap, open year-round, lodged on a rolling basis after you finish. The only deadline is that your Student visa must still be valid.
2026-12-31（含）之前递交，签证时长 2 年。这是旧规则的最后窗口，跨年: Lodge on or before 2026-12-31 for a 2-year visa. This is the last window under the old rule; the same application after the new year gets only 18 months.
2027-01-01 起递交，签证时长 18 个月；博士或其他博士级学历仍为 3: From 2027-01-01 the visa lasts 18 months; PhD or other doctoral qualifications still get 3 years.
按年计，官方原文 usually £1,035 for each year yo: Charged per year: `usually £1,035 for each year you'll be in the UK`
官方原文：`you'll usually get a decision on y: Official wording: `you'll usually get a decision on your visa within 8 weeks`. You may stay in the UK while waiting.
由院校直接通知内政部，申请人无需自行提交；但须先确认院校已完成申报: The provider notifies the Home Office directly; you do not submit it yourself, but confirm the provider has done so
递交时该签证须仍在有效期内: Must still be valid at lodgement
按申请流程使用 UKVI 账号、人脸识别或到签证中心采集: Via the UKVI account, face verification in the app, or a visa centre appointment as directed
确认课程合格且院校已申报完成: Confirm the course is eligible and the provider has reported completion
先查官方「课程是否符合条件」页确认学历层级与最低在英学习时长；再向院校确认它已把: First check the official course-eligibility page for the qualification level and minimum UK study period; then confirm your provider has told the Home Office you completed the course. Skip this and the application is refused.
在学生签证到期前在线递交: Lodge online before the Student visa expires
必须本人在英国境内递交，且学生签证仍有效。不必等毕业证。: You must be in the UK and hold a valid Student visa. No need to wait for the certificate.
缴申请费与 IHS: Pay the application fee and IHS
申请费 £937；医疗附加费通常每年 £1,035，按批下来的年限一次性缴。: £937 application fee; the health surcharge is usually £1,035 per year, paid up front for the full grant.
核验身份并等待决定: Verify identity and wait for the decision
按提示用 App 完成人脸与证件核验，或预约签证中心。通常 8 周内出结果，等待: Complete face and document checks in the app, or book a visa centre. Decisions usually arrive within 8 weeks, and you may stay lawfully while waiting.
不可延期（官方原文 `You cannot extend your Gradua: Cannot be extended (`You cannot extend your Graduate visa.`). Before it expires you can switch to another route, such as Skilled Worker.
可从事绝大多数工作、可求职、可自雇、可做志愿工作、可出入境。唯一限制在学习：只有: You may work in most jobs, look for work, be self-employed, volunteer, and travel in and out. The only restriction is study: you may study only courses that are not themselves eligible for a Student visa. Lodge by 2026-12-31 for 2 years; after that 18 months; PhD 3 years.
2027-01-01 起时长从 2 年缩到 18 个月。差一天递交，少 6 个月: From 2027-01-01 the duration drops from 2 years to 18 months. One day later means 6 months less, with no remedy.
必须在英国境内、且学生签证未过期时递交。回国后再申请不成立。: You must apply in the UK while the Student visa is still valid. Applying after returning home does not work.
不可延期。这段时间事实上是找担保工作的窗口，不是长期居留方案，到期未转签就得离境: Not extendable. This period is effectively a window to find a sponsoring job, not a long-term settlement route; leave or switch before it ends.
费用合计不低：£937 申请费加每年 £1,035 医疗附加费，2 年档约 £3: Total cost is significant: £937 plus £1,035 per year of IHS, roughly £3,007 for the 2-year grant (about CNY 28,000), non-refundable.
优势：不需要雇主担保、不限岗位、可自雇，是从留学转工作的最低摩擦路径；博士 3: Advantages: no sponsor needed, no job restriction, self-employment allowed — the lowest-friction bridge from study to work; PhD holders get 3 years.
时长原文：`A Graduate visa gives you permissi: Duration: `A Graduate visa gives you permission to stay in the UK for at least 18 months after successfully completing an eligible course in the UK.`; `2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026`, `18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027`, `If you have a PhD or other doctoral qualification, it will last for 3 years.`; `You cannot extend your Graduate visa.` Fees: `pay the £937 application fee`, `pay the healthcare surcharge - this is usually £1,035 for each year you'll be in the UK`. Decision: `you'll usually get a decision on your visa within 8 weeks`. Permissions: `work in most jobs`, `look for work`, `be self-employed`, `travel abroad and return to the UK`.
四条须同时成立：`you're in the UK`、`your current: All four must hold: `you're in the UK`; `your current visa is a Student visa or Tier 4 (General) student visa`; `you studied a UK bachelor's degree, postgraduate degree or other eligible course for a minimum period of time with your Student visa or Tier 4 (General) student visa`; `your education provider ... has told the Home Office you've successfully completed your course`. Also: `You must apply before your Student visa or Tier 4 (General) student visa expires.` and `You do not have to wait until you've graduated or have been given a certificate.` **Neither this page nor the overview sets an age limit, a separate language requirement or a funds threshold.**
美国国务院 J-1 交流访问者项目下的实习类别：在美企业从事与所学专业相关的实习: The internship category of the US Department of State's J-1 Exchange Visitor Program: an internship with a US employer in your field of study, up to 12 months. Participants must be full-time students at a post-secondary institution outside the US, or have graduated within the past 12 months. The difference from Trainee is that Intern targets students and recent graduates, while Trainee targets people with a qualification plus work experience. A State Department-designated sponsor is mandatory and the placement must be secured in advance.
22 CFR 62.22 未对国籍设限，只要求是 foreign nationa: 22 CFR 62.22 sets no nationality restriction, requiring only that you be a foreign national. Mainland Chinese passport holders may apply, provided a designated sponsor accepts them and an internship placement is secured.
法规未设年龄上下限，只限定学籍状态。这里的 0-99 表示「官方无年龄要求」，不: The regulations set no age floor or ceiling, only enrolment status. A 0-99 range here means 'no official age requirement', not 'unverified'. In practice the sponsor judges whether you can complete the internship.
须满足其一：在境外学位或证书授予类高等教育机构全日制在读，且所学方向即实习方向；: One of: full-time enrolment at a degree- or certificate-granting post-secondary institution outside the US, in the field the internship covers; or graduation from such an institution within the past 12 months. The internship must relate to your field, checked item by item through the DS-7002 (T/IPP).
须具备可核验的英语能力，足以在实习环境日常沟通。核验方式三选一：认可的英语考试、: Verifiable English ability sufficient to function day to day in the internship. Verified one of three ways: a recognised English test, written confirmation from a school, or a documented interview by the sponsor (in person, by video or by phone). No cut-off is set, so no test or score is listed.
法规未设资金门槛。但须自付项目费、往返机票与前期食宿，项目费金额官方不公布、由各: No funds threshold in the regulations, but you cover the programme fee, airfare and initial living costs yourself; the fee is not published and each sponsor sets it. If the internship is paid, pay must match what US counterparts earn in the same role.
须有雇主签署的 DS-7002（Training/Internship Plac: A DS-7002 (Training/Internship Placement Plan) signed by the employer, itemising the training content and duties. The sponsor may only issue the DS-2019 after all signatures are in place.
在读生须提供境外院校的在读证明；应届生须提供毕业证明，且毕业日期距项目开始不超过: Students need proof of enrolment from their institution abroad; recent graduates need proof of graduation dated no more than 12 months before the programme starts.
官方未设年度名额上限。每年 5 月 1 日为项目年度起始日，具体报名与岗位安置日: No annual cap is set. The programme year begins on 1 May; intake and placement calendars are set by each sponsor.
官方项目页与法规均不公布统一报名窗口，由各 Sponsor 自行安排，故记为未核: Neither the programme page nor the regulations publish a common application window; each sponsor arranges its own, so this is recorded as unverified. Internships run up to 12 months and can be extended within that cap with a new DS-7002.
官方未公布审理时长（未能核实）。SEVIS I-901 费须在面签前缴纳。签证费: Processing time is not published (unverified). The SEVIS I-901 fee must be paid before the visa interview. The MRV visa fee could not be verified this round: travel.state.gov returned 403 on several channels from this machine, so it is recorded as unverified rather than borrowed from another category.
由国务院指定 Sponsor 签发，是申请 J-1 签证的核心文件: Issued by a State Department-designated sponsor; the core document for the J-1 visa
须由申请人、雇主、Sponsor 三方签字，写明岗位职责与培训目标: Signed by applicant, employer and sponsor, stating duties and training objectives
证明全日制在读，或毕业不超过 12 个月: Shows full-time enrolment, or graduation within the past 12 months
J-1 通则 $220，须在面签前缴纳: J-1 general rate $220, paid before the interview
确认自己符合学籍条件: Confirm you meet the enrolment condition
两条路：境外高校全日制在读且实习方向与专业一致；或毕业不超过 12 个月。在读证: Two routes: full-time study at an institution abroad in the same field as the internship, or graduation within 12 months. Proof of enrolment and the graduation date are the first two things a sponsor checks; fail either and nothing else matters.
必须经国务院指定的 Sponsor，无法自行向国务院申请。Sponsor 名单可: Only through a designated sponsor; you cannot apply to the State Department directly. Filter the official sponsor list by Intern.
落实实习岗位并签 DS-7002: Secure the placement and sign the DS-7002
雇主须签署 DS-7002，写明岗位职责、培训目标与时长。Sponsor 会核查: The employer signs the DS-7002 stating duties, training objectives and duration. The sponsor vets the employer, including a site visit for first-time hosts.
Sponsor 须核验英语能力并做记录性面试，方式三选一：考试、学校书面证明、S: The sponsor verifies English ability and conducts a documented interview, using one of three routes: a test, school confirmation, or its own interview.
缴纳 SEVIS 费并申请签证: Pay the SEVIS fee and apply for the visa
拿到 DS-2019 后缴 SEVIS I-901 费 $220，再预约面签。面: After the DS-2019 arrives, pay the $220 SEVIS I-901 fee and book the interview. Bring the signed DS-7002 to the interview.
可在 12 个月上限内延期，条件是完整填写并执行新的 DS-7002。完成实习后: Extendable within the 12-month cap by completing and executing a new DS-7002. Once you no longer qualify as an Intern, you may apply as a Trainee after two years of residence outside the US.
涉及儿童照护、老人照护的岗位: Positions involving childcare or elder care
涉及医疗患者护理或接触的岗位: Positions involving patient care or patient contact
文书或办公室支持工作占比超过 20% 的岗位: Positions with more than 20% clerical or office support work
实习须落在官方列出的 10 个职业类别内：农林渔、艺术与文化、建筑、教育/社会科: The internship must fall within the ten official occupational categories: agriculture, forestry and fishing; arts and culture; construction and building trades; education, social sciences, library science, counselling and social services; health-related occupations; hospitality and tourism; information media and communications; management, business, commerce and finance; public administration and law; and the sciences, engineering, architecture, mathematics and industrial occupations. It may not displace regular US employees.
必须经国务院指定 Sponsor，无法自主申请；且岗位须预先落实。任何「先过去再: A designated sponsor is mandatory and the placement must be secured first. Any 'fly over then find an internship' advice cannot get around the DS-7002 precondition.
实习内容必须与专业相关，由 Sponsor 逐项审核。跨专业申请会被拒，且没有申: The internship must relate to your field and is reviewed item by item. Cross-field applications are refused with no appeal route.
文书类工作不得超过 20%，也不得从事护理类岗位。想靠 J-1 去做办公室助理或: Clerical work may not exceed 20% and care roles are barred. Using J-1 to work as an office assistant or carer does not hold up legally.
12 个月上限固定，延期须重新签 DS-7002 并在上限内。想留更久只能转其他: The 12-month cap is fixed; extension needs a new DS-7002 and still fits inside the cap. Staying longer means switching visa category.
项目费官方不公布、由各 Sponsor 自定，区间可能相当大；SEVIS 费 $: The programme fee is unpublished and sponsor-set, so the range can be wide; the $220 SEVIS fee is on top, and the MRV visa fee remains unverified this round.
优势：无年龄上限、无资金门槛；官方另设 Early Career STEM Re: Advantages: no age ceiling, no funds threshold; the official Early Career STEM Research Initiative widens the pool for STEM placements.
参与人资格原文：`Interns must be foreign nationa: Eligibility: `Interns must be foreign nationals: Who are currently enrolled in and pursuing studies at a foreign degree- or certificate-granting post-secondary academic institution outside the United States; or Who have graduated from such an institution no more than 12 months prior to their exchange visitor program start date.` Limits: `Interns cannot work in unskilled or casual labor positions, in positions that require or involve childcare or elder care or in any kind of position that involves medical patient care or contact. Nor can interns work in positions that require more than 20 percent clerical or office support work.` The page lists 10 occupational categories and the Early Career STEM Research Initiative. **It publishes no age requirement, visa fee or processing time.**
22 CFR 62.22 — Trainees and interns（美国联邦: 22 CFR 62.22 — Trainees and interns (US federal regulations)
时长原文：`the maximum duration of a training: Duration: `the maximum duration of a training program is 18 months, and the maximum duration of an internship program is 12 months`, and `Program extensions are permitted within the maximum duration ... provided that the need for an extended training or internship program is documented by the full completion and execution of a new Form DS-7002.` Selection: `Are currently enrolled full-time and pursuing studies in their advanced chosen career field at a degree- or certificate-granting post-secondary academic institution outside the United States or graduated from such an institution no more than 12 months prior to their exchange visitor program begin date.` English: `Sponsors must verify an applicant's English language proficiency through a recognized English language test, by signed documentation from an academic institution or English language school, or through a documented interview`. The DS-7002 must be fully signed before the DS-2019 is issued. **No age provision appears anywhere in the section.**
费率表原文：`For exchange visitors (J-1) $220: Fee table: `For exchange visitors (J-1) $220 UNLESS participating in:` … `Camp counselor program $35`. Intern and Trainee fall under the general J-1 rate of $220. The fee must be paid before the embassy or consulate interview.
J-1 下的在职者培训类别：在美企业接受与既有专业方向一致的系统培训，最长 18: The trainee category of J-1: structured training with a US employer in your existing professional field, up to 18 months (12 months for agriculture and hospitality/tourism). The line against Intern is that Trainee targets graduates with at least one year of related experience, while Intern targets current students and people within 12 months of graduation. It is the most direct J-1 category for someone a few years into a career who wants overseas experience.
法规未对国籍设限，只要求是 foreign national。中国大陆护照持有人: No nationality restriction; you must be a foreign national. Mainland Chinese passport holders may apply if a designated sponsor accepts them and a training placement is secured.
法规未设年龄上下限，只限定学历与工作年限。0-99 表示「官方无年龄要求」，不是: No age floor or ceiling; only qualifications and years of experience are constrained. 0-99 means 'no official age requirement', not 'unverified'.
两条路满足其一即可：①持境外高等教育机构颁发的学位或专业证书，且在境外该领域有至: Either: (1) a degree or professional certificate from a post-secondary institution abroad plus at least one year of related work experience abroad in that field; or (2) at least five years of work experience abroad in that field, with no qualification requirement. The training may not duplicate your existing work experience.
须具备可核验的英语能力，足以在培训环境日常沟通。核验方式三选一：认可的英语考试、: Verifiable English ability sufficient for day-to-day communication in the training environment, verified by a recognised test, written school confirmation, or a sponsor interview. No cut-off is set.
法规未设资金门槛。须自付项目费、机票与前期食宿；项目费由各 Sponsor 自定: No funds threshold. You cover the programme fee, airfare and initial living costs; the fee is sponsor-set and unpublished.
强制。22 CFR 62.14 最低额度：医疗 $100,000、遗体送返 $2: Mandatory. 22 CFR 62.14 minimums: medical $100,000, repatriation of remains $25,000, medical evacuation $50,000, deductible no more than $500.
须有雇主签署的 DS-7002，写明培训计划与岗位职责。Sponsor 拿到全部: A DS-7002 signed by the employer stating the training plan and duties. The sponsor issues the DS-2019 only after all signatures are collected.
官方未设年度名额上限，报名与岗位安置日历由各 Sponsor 自行设定。: No annual cap; intake and placement calendars are set by each sponsor.
官方不公布统一报名窗口，记为未核实。培训最长 18 个月；农业与酒店旅游类别上限: No common application window is published, so this is recorded as unverified. Training runs up to 18 months; agriculture and hospitality/tourism cap at 12 months, and that 12 cannot be stretched to 18 by bolting on six months of classroom study.
官方未公布审理时长（未能核实）。SEVIS 费须在面签前缴纳；签证费（MRV）本: Processing time is not published (unverified). The SEVIS fee is paid before the interview; the MRV visa fee could not be verified this round.
由国务院指定 Sponsor 签发: Issued by a State Department-designated sponsor
申请人、雇主、Sponsor 三方签字: Signed by applicant, employer and sponsor
走「学历 + 1 年经验」路径时必需；走「5 年经验」路径可不提供: Required on the 'qualification + 1 year' route; not needed on the '5 years' route
1 年（有学历）或 5 年（无学历），须为境外经历: One year (with a qualification) or five years (without), and it must be experience outside the US
核对学历与工作年限的组合: Check the qualification and experience combination
有学位 → 需要 1 年境外相关经验；无学位 → 需要 5 年境外相关经验。两项: With a degree, you need one year of related experience abroad; without one, five years. Meeting neither means Intern rather than Trainee.
确认培训内容不与既有经历重复: Confirm the training does not duplicate your experience
法规明令培训不得复制申请人已有的工作经历。这一步决定岗位能不能批，选岗位时就要考: The regulations forbid training that copies your existing work experience. This decides whether the placement can be approved, so weigh it while choosing.
必须经国务院指定 Sponsor。Sponsor 名录可在官方页按 Traine: Only through a designated sponsor. Filter the official list by Trainee.
落实岗位并签 DS-7002: Secure the placement and sign the DS-7002
雇主签署培训安置计划，写明培训目标、职责与时长。Sponsor 审核雇主资质。: The employer signs the placement plan stating goals, duties and duration. The sponsor vets the employer.
缴 SEVIS 费并申请签证: Pay the SEVIS fee and apply for the visa
拿到 DS-2019 后缴 $220，预约面签，面签时出示已签署的 DS-700: Pay $220 after the DS-2019 arrives, book the interview, and bring the signed DS-7002.
可在 18 个月上限内延期，须完整执行新的 DS-7002。农业与酒店旅游类别上: Extendable within the 18-month cap with a fully executed new DS-7002; agriculture and hospitality/tourism cap at 12 months. After completing, you must spend two years outside the US before another Trainee programme; if you no longer qualify as a Trainee then, you may switch to Intern after the same two years.
涉及患者护理或接触的岗位: Positions involving patient care or contact
文书工作占比超过 20% 的岗位: Positions with more than 20% clerical work
本可由美方全职或兼职雇员充任的岗位: Positions that would otherwise be filled by US full-time or part-time employees
官方原文明确禁止把该项目当作普通就业使用：`Use of the Exchang: The regulations expressly forbid using the programme as ordinary employment: `Use of the Exchange Visitor Program for ordinary employment or work purposes is strictly prohibited.` Training must be structured and supervised on site.
不得当作普通就业渠道。法规原文禁止用该项目替代正常雇佣，岗位须是培训性质且有督导: It is not a general employment channel. The regulations bar it from substituting for regular hiring; the placement must be training-oriented and supervised.
培训内容不得重复既有工作经历。资深从业者想「去美国干本行」很可能被判不符合。: Training may not duplicate existing experience. Experienced professionals aiming to 'do their own job in the US' are likely to be found ineligible.
18 个月是上限，农业与酒店旅游只有 12 个月，且不能靠补课堂学习延长。: 18 months is the ceiling; agriculture and hospitality/tourism get only 12, and classroom hours cannot extend it.
完成后须在境外居住满 2 年才能再参加，不是「想再来就再来」。: Two years of residence outside the US is required before rejoining — it is not a repeatable-at-will programme.
优势：无年龄上限；无学历也能走「5 年经验」路径；比 Intern 多 6 个月: Advantages: no age ceiling; the five-year experience route works without a degree; six months longer than Intern.
参与人资格原文：`Has a degree or professional ce: Eligibility: `Has a degree or professional certificate from a foreign post-secondary academic institution and at least one year of prior related work experience in his or her occupational field outside the United States; or Has five years of work experience outside the United States in the occupational field in which they are seeking training`. Limits: `Trainees cannot work in unskilled or casual labor positions, in positions that require or involve childcare or elder care, or in any kind of position that involves patient care or contact.` `Use of the Exchange Visitor Program for ordinary employment or work purposes is strictly prohibited.` `the training cannot duplicate a trainee participant's prior work experience or training.`
时长原文：`the maximum duration of a training: Duration: `the maximum duration of a training program is 18 months`; `For training programs in the field of agriculture and in the occupational category of Hospitality and Tourism, the maximum duration of program participation is 12 months.`; `12-month training programs in the field of agriculture may not be extended to 18 months by adding six months of classroom participation and studies at the end of the original 12-month program duration.` Re-entry: `Trainees are eligible for additional training programs after a period of at least two years residency outside the United States following completion of their training program.`
强制保险与最低额度：医疗不低于 $100,000、遗体送返 $25,000、医疗: Mandatory insurance with minimums: medical at least $100,000, repatriation of remains $25,000, medical evacuation $50,000, deductible no more than $500.
J-1 通则 $220；仅 Summer work/travel、Au pair: J-1 general rate is $220; only Summer work/travel, Au pair and Camp counselor are $35, and Trainee is not on the reduced list.
